title: Identification of Metabolic Phenotypes Associated With Melanoma Metastasis
official: Identification of Metabolic Phenotypes Associated With Melanoma Metastasis
summary: The goal of this study is to observe metabolic features associated with human melanoma tumors.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with known or probable malignant melanoma lesions requiring surgical biopsy or excision.
* Subjects of all races and ethnic origins over age 18.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not a surgical candidate
* Poorly controlled diabetes
sponsor: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center
